methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: ODU and Google launch AI incubator to boost innovation in Hampton Roads - MSN
signals.signal_reading: ODU-Google AI incubator concentrates deep institutional capability in Hampton Roads metro hub, creating regional excellence but requiring intentional distribution mechanisms to reach surrounding communities and avoid reinforcing metro-centric AI development patterns.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA explicitly aims to build community-level AI literacy and education infrastructure, signaling intentional effort to create distributed, deeper capability beyond elite institutions through accessible learning pathways.

signals.title: Healthcare providers say AI helps them focus on patients. But it also raises questions about privacy, security and the role of humans in medicine
signals.signal_reading: Healthcare providers in historically underserved regions adopting AI for note-taking and communication represents shallow, platform-delivered automation that enables productivity but doesn't build local AI development capability or technical depth.

signals.title: Problem-solvers by nature: How Virginia Beach Fire put AI to work - FireRescue1
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Beach Fire's deployment of AI for operational problem-solving demonstrates deep application capability in a specific institutional context, but remains concentrated within a well-resourced municipal agency rather than distributed across the broader Hampton Roads workforce.

signals.title: Pentagon Expands Scale AI Deal to $500M and AI Defense Firm TurbineOne Moves HQ to Northern Virginia - Clearance Jobs
signals.signal_reading: Pentagon's $500M Scale AI expansion and TurbineOne's HQ relocation to NoVA intensifies defense-tech AI concentration in the region, deepening the capability gap as federal dollars and specialized talent cluster around DC-adjacent opportunities unavailable elsewhere in Virginia.
